messages:
elena: Opening PR to update SDK docs: streaming now yields delta chunks, pagination param renamed to cursor, and we want a short resume/token example + backoff helper. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4527

mike: nice. Can we make the Python example explicitly assemble partial chunks so users don't expect a single final object?

elena: yes — default example will be async iterator + a tiny sync wrapper for quick demos.

priya: for Go examples please add ctx cancellation and explicit io.EOF handling. We had a flaky test that hung when examples omitted cancel.

mike: suggested Python snippet:```py
buf = []
async for ev in client.stream(req):
    if ev.type == 'delta':
        buf.append(ev.text)
result = ''.join(buf)
```
callout: mention storing resume tokens and handling stop signals.

priya: Go snippet idea:```go
ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 30*time.Second)
defer cancel()
stream, err := client.Stream(ctx, req)
for {
  ev, err := stream.Recv()
  if err == io.EOF { break }
  if err != nil { // classify transient vs fatal; backoff/retry }
  // handle ev
}
```
note: import context,time,io.

mike: TS snippet (for docs):```ts
let out = ''
for await (const ev of client.stream(req)) {
  if (ev.type === 'delta') out += ev.text
}
```
callout: mention Node version compatibility for for-await.

elena: added an "Advanced patterns" backoff util (exponential jitter) and a short note about batching increasing p99 latency. I kept the older convenience snippet under a migration section.

ci-bot: PR opened: docs#4527  CI: examples-lint / docs-build queued. Reviewers requested: @mike @priya.

priya: I changed remaining page_token references to cursor in list helpers and pushed a tiny rename. Please grep for helpers that still mention page_token.

mike: verified py + ts use cursor. One Go helper was updated by priya. lgtm pending CI.

elena: perfect. Once CI passes I'll merge and add a short note in breaking-changes.md explaining stream iterator + cursor rename and the resume-token pattern. Will ping support for runbook updates.

docs-bot: examples-sanity passed for docs#4527. docs-build queued.

elena: thanks everyone — I'll merge after final green. Ping here if anything else shows up.
